title: Open scalar transport of the comparison into ordinary tensor pullback
statement: Let f:X to S, f prime:X prime to S prime, g:S prime to S and g prime:X prime to X form a cartesian square of schemes. Choose base opens V,V prime with V prime contained in g inverse V and a commuting j between U prime=f prime inverse V prime and U=f inverse V, such that the restricted square is cartesian. Choose derived categories. For every cochain complex P on X, z in U prime and integer i, let Q0 be its literal termwise restriction. Define the ordinary comparison by the localized base-derived tensor cohomology comparison, tensorStalkIso on homology, and the inverse comparisonStalkHomologyIso. There exists an additive isomorphism l of its sources for Q0 and P such that the ordinary comparison on Q0, followed by stalk cohomology of beta [def-pc-single-complex-open-tensor-restriction-iso] and the constructed openDerivedAdditiveStalkIso [def-pc-open-derived-additive-stalk-iso] at Q(g prime* P), equals l followed by the ordinary comparison on P. No K-flatness or invertibility of a derived counit is assumed.

proof.text: Apply ordinary open germ transport to obtain the four compatible ring isomorphisms, the semilinear input complex isomorphism alpha, the pure-tensor chain isomorphism tau and its target-path homology compatibility.

Apply coefficient-ring transport to the two cohomologyModel objects and those ring and chain isomorphisms. Obtain l and the square for the localizedComparison maps before the ordinary stalk identifications.

Expand comparisonIntoTensorPullback as localizedComparison followed by tensorStalkIso homology and the inverse stalk homology factor. Compose the scalar square with the ambient target factor, substitute the ordinary target-path equation and reassociate. This is the required square with l.

theorem exists_singleComplexOpen_ordinary_comparison
    [∀ Y : Scheme.{u},
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    {X X' S S' : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ S) (f' : X' ⟶ S') (g : S' ⟶ S) (g' : X' ⟶ X)
    (sq : IsPullback g' f' f g)
    (V : S.Opens) (V' : S'.Opens) (hV' : V' ≤ g ⁻¹ᵁ V)
    (j : (f' ⁻¹ᵁ V').toScheme ⟶ (f ⁻¹ᵁ V).toScheme)
    (hj : j ≫ (f ⁻¹ᵁ V).ι = (f' ⁻¹ᵁ V').ι ≫ g')
    (sq₀ : IsPullback j (f' ∣_ V') (f ∣_ V) (g.resLE V V' hV'))
    (P : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) ℤ)
    (z : (f' ⁻¹ᵁ V').toScheme) (i : ℤ) :
    letI : (schemeOpenRestriction X (f ⁻¹ᵁ V)).Additive :=
      schemeOpenRestriction_additive X (f ⁻¹ᵁ V)
    letI : (schemeOpenRestriction X (f ⁻¹ᵁ V)).PreservesZeroMorphisms :=
      Functor.preservesZeroMorphisms_of_additive _
    let Q := ((schemeOpenRestriction X (f ⁻¹ᵁ V)).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P
    let F₀ := forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u} ((f' ⁻¹ᵁ V').toScheme.presheaf.stalk z)) AddCommGrpCat.{u}
    let F := forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u} (X'.presheaf.stalk z.val)) AddCommGrpCat.{u}
    let H₀ := comparisonStalkCohomology (f' ⁻¹ᵁ V').toScheme z i
    let β := singleComplexOpenTensorRestrictionMap g' (f ⁻¹ᵁ V) (f' ⁻¹ᵁ V') j hj P
    let ν := openDerivedAdditiveStalkIso X' (f' ⁻¹ᵁ V') z i
    ∃ l : F₀.obj ((Arrow.mk (comparisonIntoTensorPullback (f ∣_ V) (f' ∣_ V')
        (g.resLE V V' hV') j sq₀ z Q i)).left) ≅
        F.obj ((Arrow.mk (comparisonIntoTensorPullback f f' g g' sq z.val P i)).left),
      F₀.map (comparisonIntoTensorPullback (f ∣_ V) (f' ∣_ V')
          (g.resLE V V' hV') j sq₀ z Q i) ≫
        F₀.map (H₀.map β) ≫
          ν.hom.app (DerivedCategory.Q.obj
            (((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback g').mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P)) =
      l.hom ≫ F.map (comparisonIntoTensorPullback f f' g g' sq z.val P i)
